source.method: How this is scored: each entry is priced at the market when it was posted. If the source later posted its own exit, the call is judged on that exit. If not, it is judged on the next five trading days (five calendar days for coins): a win means the price ran at least 2% the called way at some point. Option calls are followed on the stock, not the option. Trust is the win rate marked down for a small sample.
